Class EndGameScreen

java.lang.Object
org.adsl.client.view.Screen<TUIScreen>
org.adsl.client.view.tui.screens.TUIScreen
org.adsl.client.view.tui.screens.EndGameScreen
All Implemented Interfaces:
EventVisitor<TUIScreen>, InputEventVisitor
public class EndGameScreen extends TUIScreen
Displays the single-match standings on the left and the cumulative DB leaderboard on the right; when the DB is unavailable the right column is replaced by a red alert. On ConfirmEvent (Enter) transitions to ExitScreen to terminate the TUI.

      public EndGameScreen(TuiTerminal terminal, AppCoordinator coordinator, String username, List<MatchResult> results, List<DBRecord> records, String message)
      Parameters:
      terminal - the TUI terminal used for rendering
      coordinator - the coordinator used to send requests to the server
      username - the current player's username
      results - per-player results for this match, or null if the game ended before it started
      records - overall leaderboard records from the database, or null/empty if unavailable
      message - optional message shown when records is unavailable
